t: You're standing at 242 to 245 High Holborn, where Weston's Music Hall once stood. It opened on the sixteenth of November 1857 as a music hall and theatre. In 1906 it was renamed the Holborn Empire, and it lasted as a place of entertainment until 1941. It was designed by Finch Hill, a Victorian architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. Little of the building's own story is supplied here, so picture a busy Victorian entertainment house on this stretch of High Holborn.
